actual_supported_evidence.verification_scope: Existing saved-prediction arithmetic/ID/text/label/order verification, plus direct inspection of summary and epoch history in this subtask. No re-evaluation of predictions, training or inference.
actual_supported_evidence.training_design_label: Author-supplied run summary says no augmentation; exact executed training-input identity remains unsupported by a recovered actual manifest

recipe.pretrained_revision: unfixed/default Hub revision in reference; actual baseline unknown
recipe.input: raw original Text cast to str; no explicit stopword removal or external normalization
recipe.integrity_key: NFKC + whitespace collapse/trim + casefold, used for checks only
recipe.checkpoint_rule: Replace selected checkpoint only when validation macro F1 > previous selected +0.001
recipe.class_weights: (N_train/(6*n_train_class))**0.5, divided by arithmetic mean of six weights
recipe.training_loss: CrossEntropyLoss(weight=weights), default weighted-mean reduction on each microbatch
recipe.gradient_accumulation_implementation: Each independently normalized microbatch loss divided by number of microbatches in accumulation window
recipe.training_precision: BF16 when CUDA reports support; otherwise FP16 + GradScaler
recipe.validation_precision: Autocast forward then FP32 logits/softmax; not an explicitly full FP32 forward
recipe.metrics: Explicit class indices 0..5 macro F1 and weighted F1, accuracy; exported dataset classes 1..6; zero_division=0

proposed_new_recipe.basis: Explicit reference settings, corroborating actual epoch/LR observations where available, and requested correctness improvements
proposed_new_recipe.initialization: Official original pretrained weights at a newly pinned immutable revision; never historical fine-tuned checkpoint
proposed_new_recipe.checkpoint_rule: Save every strict improvement in literal validation macro F1; earliest epoch wins exact ties. Use min_delta only for stopping progress counter.
proposed_new_recipe.class_weights: Same reference square-root frequency formula, computed separately only from actual A/B training labels and saved
proposed_new_recipe.gradient_reduction: Backpropagate summed weighted CE numerators, then divide accumulated gradients by sum of true-class weights across the complete window before clipping/stepping
proposed_new_recipe.training_precision: BF16 on the specified supported RTX GPU; record actual precision and fail rather than silently alter recipe
proposed_new_recipe.validation_precision: Explicit FP32 model forward/logits/softmax to meet full-precision validation requirement; save lossless float32 arrays and unrounded CSV probability columns
proposed_new_recipe.preprocessing: Preserved raw Text only; tokenizer performs its own standard uncased preprocessing; integrity normalization does not rewrite model input
proposed_new_recipe.evaluation: Frozen validation bytes/order only; Class 1..6 and model indices0..5 fixed; no test entry point

corroboration_not_proof: 296 optimizer steps is consistent with ceil(ceil(4731/8)/2), but also other batch/accumulation choices; do not identify batch size from it.
18 logged epochs with best epoch10 is consistent with patience8, but does not prove the actual early-stopping or epoch-cap configuration.
LR2e-5 until logged epoch14 and1e-5 from15 is consistent with reference plateau scheduler, but not a recovered actual scheduler configuration.
scientifically_material_reference_issues: Averaging separately normalized weighted microbatch means does not equal weighted CE over the combined effective batch. Unequal sum-of-class-weight denominators and uneven final microbatches cause differences.
Meaningful-improvement checkpoint replacement at min_delta0.001 can skip a later literal maximum macro F1. It happened to select the actual maximum in this saved epoch log.
Reference initialization revision is not pinned; actual original pretrained revision/config/tokenizer are absent.
Reference AMP validation can produce different probabilities/metrics from a full FP32 forward; actual baseline precision remains unknown.
actual_baseline_artifacts_missing_in_sco: Actual experiment_provenance.json and class_weights.json or equivalent exact weight values/formula binding
Executed original training/evaluation notebook/script with configuration and input-hash record
Original pretrained immutable revision and tokenizer identity used in the actual run
comparison_boundary: A/B results on the same frozen validation can be reported as exploratory descriptive comparisons with 0.5811396777932097. Without the actual historical recipe, differences cannot be attributed solely to augmentation. A future matched unaugmented control or recovered and verified actual recipe is needed for a controlled augmentation-effect claim; do not automatically add such a run under the current priority.
additional_limits: Class weights intentionally change with the A/B training-label frequencies, even when their formula is fixed.
Same maximum epochs implies more optimizer updates for larger training variants; save actual updates/epochs and disclose this training-budget difference.
Single-seed validation selection and repeated use of the same validation partition do not establish statistical superiority or final generalization.
Automatic flag filtering does not validate unflagged synthetic labels; all inherited synthetic labels remain provisional.
